- **docs(arch): blocking-frontiers 갱신 — TF32 r4 결과 + plateau 하드웨어 🧱 + BF16 research-found 경로 (research-driven 루프 기록)**: ARCHITECTURE.json frontier 노드를 측정·인용 결과로 업데이트. **TF32**: r4 Split-K가 256을 0.92~0.94×로 닫아 own이 cuBLAS 추월(wave-quantization fix·cuBLAS splitK 커널명 예측 적중), 512-3072 plateau는 **하드웨어 천장 🧱 research-confirmed**(consumer GeForce Blackwell이 FP32-accum 텐서 처리량 반속 cap → dense ceiling≈own ~30TFLOP/s, cuBLAS ~34는 roofline내 스케줄링 micro-overlap·exclusive 기법 아님; WingEdge parity도 compute throttle 종착·warp-spec 없이 도달→multi-week 재작성 부정당) → r5 DEFER. **BF16**: own 배선됨(rel-RMS 0·3-7× 느림=dispatch 오버헤드), research가 ≥0.85× 달성가능 확인(WingEdge mma.sync HGEMM sm_120 parity·cuBLAS 동일 mma.sync HMMA), BF16 r3 GPU 진행중(direct-bf16-mma+epilogue-cast+scratch-reuse로 3×malloc/3 cast 제거). Split-K는 byte-determinism 깨므로 BF16 default 부적용.


- **docs(arch): ARCHITECTURE.json 에 `blocking-frontiers` 섹션 추가 — 측정된 벽 + research-state 박제 (research-targetable SSOT)**: 현재 stated-goal 을 막는 아키텍처 벽들을 메모리에 흩지 말고 설계 SSOT(ARCHITECTURE.json)에 **측정 root-cause + research-state**로 기록 → 다음 research-first 라운드(c23)가 재유도 없이 표적화. 3 frontier 노드: ⓐ **forge GPU GEMM → cuBLAS 독립(`-lcublas` 제거)** — FP64 own default ✅·TF32 🔬·BF16 in-tree 배선대기 📦·FP32 packed-gemv 🧱·`-lcublas` 제거는 escape-hatch oracle 정책 게이트 📦. ⓑ **TF32 own sm_120 parity** — r2 multi-tile/deep/swizzle 🧱measured-falsified(48-SM occupancy-bound) → r3 research 가 cuBLAS=`splitK+tmaAB` 커널명 디코드로 미시도 레버 특정 → r4 Stream-K+TMA 🔬 진행. ⓒ **zero-c leg B** 📦(self-host floor 소진 후 잔여, rt.c 통째교체 risk budget 게이트). 상태범례 🔬OPEN/🧱MEASURED-CLOSED/📦DEFERRED. round-trip 청결 삽입(107+/0-), JSON 유효. SSOT detail = 각 memory 파일 cross-ref.


- **fix(release): finalize 레이스 근본수정 — 보조 잡(musl/cuda)이 stable flip 을 prerelease 로 되돌리던 race (c1)**: `release.yml` 의 `finalize`(prerelease→stable Latest 승격) 가 3 코어타깃(darwin·x86_64·arm64)만 `needs` 해서, finalize 가 prerelease=false 로 flip 한 뒤 **finalize 의 needs 에 없던 보조 잡(linux-arm64-musl 등)이 늦게 끝나며 같은 태그에 prerelease=true 로 재업로드해 flip 을 덮어썼다**(모든 per-target 잡이 prerelease:true/make_latest:false 로 업로드). 그 결과 **v0.246~v0.262 가 전부 Pre-release 로 좌초**하고 소비자 `Latest` 가 v0.245.3 에 동결됨(실측: v0.262.0 finalize 12:38:38 success 직후 linux-arm64-musl 12:45:22 가 덮어씀). **fix**: finalize 가 **모든 업로드 잡**(musl/cuda 포함)을 `needs` → 항상 마지막 실행(레이스 제거) + `always()` + 명시적 **3 코어 success 게이트**(musl/cuda 실패는 stable 차단 안 함 — 기존 3-core 의도 유지, clobber 만 제거). v0.262.0 는 run 종료 후 수동 flip 으로 이미 stable Latest 승격(own-GEMM default-ON 소비자 출하).

- **docs(dojo): TF32 own-GEMM 'parity-band' 정정 — stale '1.10× bit-exact' 교체 (c2)**: `docs/hexa-dojo.md` own-GEMM 워러스토리의 `sm_120` 정정 블록이 TF32 own 을 "1.10× bit-exact" 로 적었으나, 2026-06-20 sm_120 square sweep 실측은 **parity-band**(@768 1.05×·@2048 parity·256/512/1024/4096 은 cuBLAS-TF32 가 12~46% 빠름 · opt/pipe 변종 전수도 미추월)이고 vs cuBLAS-TF32 정확도는 **rel-RMS ~1e-5(bit-exact 아님)** — bit-exact 인 건 FP64 own 뿐. FP64 own(1.15~1.24× 전 shape·rel-RMS 0)은 정확하므로 유지. TF32 own 의 가치는 perf 가 아니라 byte-eq 결정성·cuBLAS 독립으로 정정.


- **feat(codegen + self-host valop): `__hx_payload_div`/`__hx_payload_mod` int-div leaf 신설 → `hexa_div`/`hexa_mod` int/int native 해금 (int-div-leaf r1)**: valop seed lane 이 아니라 **codegen 신규 intrinsic lane** — sh-print-fmt census 가 지목한 "다음 진짜 진척 = codegen-extension". 기존 valop seed 가 add/sub/mul 까지였던 건 int-divide leaf 부재 때문(census 확정). **2단계**: ① **leaf 신설(byte-eq-safe by construction — 새 op string, 기존 emit 무변)**: `compiler/check/bind.hexa` intrinsic 테이블 + 양타깃 native lowering. x86_64(`x86_64_linux.hexa`) = `idiv` 의 RDX:RAX 제약상 add/sub/mul `op r10,r11` 2-op shape 에 안 맞아 **전용 블록**(`mov rax,r10; cqo; idiv r11` → div=rax/mod=rdx → r10) — 컴파일러의 기존 `/` operator idiv 경로(`_x86_is_arith_div`)와 동일 패턴. arm64(`arm64_darwin.hexa`, darwin+linux 양 ABI) = `sdiv` 3-op 적합, mod=`sdiv x4 + msub x1,x4,x3,x1`(rem=a-(a/b)*b) — 전용 블록(add/sub/mul 무변). C-transpile(`self/codegen.hexa`)도 `HX_INT/`·`%` 추가. **div-by-zero 는 leaf 밖**(zero-throw=runtime re-entry): C wrapper `HX_INT(b)!=0` 가드 후에만 native, b==0 은 rt_div/rt_mod 폴백 throw. INT64_MIN/-1 #DE 는 C `/` 동일 UB(무가드). ② **seed 배선(valop 패턴 #3704/3729/3731)**: `stdlib/runtime/valop_core.hexa::rt_div_native`/`rt_mod_native`(int/int만) + `self/runtime_core_emit.hexa` `hexa_div`/`hexa_mod` arm. stage_resolve globl 8→10, regen SYMS 10, valop_core_gate.c PART G + wrapper. **C `#else` RETAIN**. **self-host≠release ABSOLUTE · codegen 변경=byteeq 위험 큼** → leaf 가 새 op string(dead until 사용)이라 gen3≡gen4 무변경이 안전벨트, fresh #3714 aprime_cc regen + micro-byteeq(native==C int div/mod) + byteeq 3타깃 GREEN(PR CI 권위) 후 머지. **mod 동시 해금**(idiv remainder 부산물 + arm64 sdiv+msub). **NEXT(r2)**: 머지 후 valop family 재판정(7-prim) 또는 `__fd_write_bytes` @syscall6 lowering(print 해금) 또는 floor 종결 선언.
- **feat(forge): own-GEMM default-ON — production GPU GEMM 이 cuBLAS 대신 own-kernel 을 기본으로 (HEXA_OWN_GEMM/HEXA_TF32_OWN 0=opt-out)**: forge production `self/cuda/runtime_cuda_emit.hexa` 의 7개 GEMM 게이트(FP64 6 + TF32 1)를 **opt-in→default-ON** 으로 전환. **구현**: `_forge_own_gemm_on()`/`_forge_tf32_own_on()` 헬퍼 2개 추가(default 1, `HEXA_OWN_GEMM=0`/`HEXA_TF32_OWN=0` 일 때만 0=cuBLAS) → 7개 `getenv("HEXA_OWN_GEMM") && [0]` 호출 지점을 헬퍼로 교체(미설정/=1 → own, =0 → cuBLAS opt-out). **byte-eq 갈림(c2 핵심)**: FP64 own `_hx_k_gemm` 은 cuBLAS Dgemm 과 accum-order 공유로 **bit-identical**(rel-RMS 0) → default-ON 이 **byte-neutral**(회귀 아님, sm_120 엔 FP64 텐서코어 부재로 cuBLAS 도 SIMT). TF32 own `mma.sync` 는 cublasGemmEx 와 accum 달라 **byte-changing** 이나 `HEXA_TF32_FASTMODE` 하위 레인(이미 비결정 근사)에서만 발화 → 기본 non-fastmode FP64 경로의 결정성 계약 무영향. **lockstep 문서**: README(3지점)·CLAUDE.md(reference-first 디렉티브)·docs/hexa-dojo.md(byte-eq GPU 학습 스위치)·memory 동반갱신 — "opt-in·OFF 비트동일" → "default-ON·opt-OUT". **머지 게이트(self-host≠release ABSOLUTE)**: GPU GEMM 출력은 PR CI faithful-nobaseline(컴파일러 self-host 바이트)이 **안 잡음** → **aiden GPU byteeq 측정**(FP64 own==cuBLAS bit-id 캡처 + TF32 fastmode-scoped diff 확인) GREEN 전 머지 금지. OFF(=0) 경로는 기존 cuBLAS 와 0줄 변경 = byte-id.

- **feat(self-host valop): `rt_cmp_{lt,gt,le,ge}_native` — sh-val-core 패밀리 5번째 prim (hexa_cmp 스칼라 순서비교) → native seed (sh-val-core EXTEND r2)**: valop-core native seed 패밀리(truthy/sub/mul/add #3704/#3714/#3729)를 `hexa_cmp_*` 스칼라 순서비교(int-int / int|float)로 확장. **포팅(c1)**: `stdlib/runtime/valop_core.hexa` 에 4개 native 본문 — int-int 는 `__hx_payload_{lt,gt,le,ge}`(signed-i64 compare leaf, map_core/rt_str 검증), float/mixed 는 `__hx_to_double` + `__hx_payload_{flt,fgt,fle,fge}`. 각각 TAG_BOOL HexaVal(`__hx_make_val(2, …)`) 반환 = `hexa_bool` 이미지 동일. un-nested 1-op-per-temp, 순수 read·NO alloc/libm/@syscall/re-entry. **재귀위험 없음(중요)**: census 가 경고한 `rt_cmp_le → eq → cmp_le` 무한재귀는 hexa-source `rt_cmp` 의 `-1`/HexaVal-`==` 경로 문제이고, 이 native 본문은 raw leaf(`__hx_payload_lt` 등)만 읽어 hexa_eq/hexa_cmp 를 절대 재진입하지 않음. **NaN**: float leaf 는 ucomisd/fcmp 로 lower → NaN 시 모든 비교 false = `__raw_cmp3` code-3(unordered) 의미와 동일. **wiring**: `self/runtime_core_emit.hexa` 의 `hexa_cmp_*`(HEXA_HAS_HEXA_RT_STDLIB 분기, 셀프호스트 출하 경로) 에 `#ifdef HEXA_RT_VALOP_NATIVE` arm 추가 — `_HX_CMP_NATIVE_ELIGIBLE`(둘 다 strict TAG_INT/TAG_FLOAT) 일 때만 `rt_cmp_*_native` 위임, enum-pair(`_hexa_enum_pair_idx`)·string(`hxlcl_strcmp`)·valstruct·incomparable-throw 는 `rt_cmp_*`(hexa-source) 폴백으로 C 잔류(guard-C/body-native split). enum-as-TAG_INT bare form 은 int payload 로 비교 = C int arm + `_hexa_enum_pair_idx(plain-int)=false` 동일. **C `#else` 본문 RETAIN**(no-seed fallback). `stage_resolve` seed globl 4→8, regen SYMS 8개, `valop_core_gate.c` PART F(4-op×16-pair cmp 오라클: int/mixed/float/eq/NaN-unordered/±inf) + wrapper. **self-host≠release ABSOLUTE 준수**: 시드 8/8 전엔 C cmp(rt_cmp) 그대로 = 무회귀. 시드 .s 3타깃 regen(**fresh #3714 aprime_cc 필수** — stale 면 arm64 bl hexa_truthy SIGSEGV, dispatch 가드) + micro-byteeq(native==C cmp) + byteeq 3타깃 GREEN(PR CI 권위) 후 머지. **NEXT(sh-val-core r3 / depletion)**: valop-native-SEED family 사실상 EXHAUST — `hexa_div`/`hexa_mod` 는 int-div leaf 부재(`__hx_payload_div` 없음 · `__raw_idiv` 는 C bridge=re-entry) + zero-div throw 로 native-seed 클래스 불가(float arm만 부분 가능·저ROI), `hexa_eq/lt/gt/ge` 는 이미 hexa-source 포팅(별 클래스). 다음 lane = sh-print-fmt(hexa_print_val/println/eprint) 또는 sh-str-builder.

- **feat(self-host valop): `rt_add_native` — sh-val-core 패밀리 4번째 prim (hexa_add 스칼라 산술) → native seed (sh-val-core EXTEND r1)**: valop-core native seed 패밀리(`rt_truthy/sub/mul_native`, #3704 keystone + #3714 arm64 3타깃)를 다음 on-path prim `hexa_add` 의 스칼라 산술 경로로 확장. **포팅(c1)**: `stdlib/runtime/valop_core.hexa::rt_add_native(a,b)` = `rt_sub_native`/`rt_mul_native` 와 **동형**(int+int → TAG_INT `__hx_payload_add(a,b)` 2-arg signed-i64 add box · 그 외 → TAG_FLOAT `__hx_payload_fadd(__hx_to_double(a), __hx_to_double(b))`), un-nested 1-op-per-temp(NESTING-SEGV 가드), 순수 read·NO alloc/libm/@syscall/re-entry. leaf intrinsic(`__hx_tag`/`__hx_payload_eq/ne/and/add`/`__hx_payload_fadd`/`__hx_to_double`/`__hx_make_val`)은 gen2-native-only(hexat C-transpile 불가) → 프로즌 시드(`self/native/valop_core_*.s`)로만 runtime.a 진입. **wiring**: `self/runtime_core_emit.hexa` 의 `hexa_add_slow`(int+int hexa_add MACRO 뒤 slow path) 에 `#ifdef HEXA_RT_VALOP_NATIVE` arm 추가 — bool→int coerce 는 C 유지, `_na && _nb`(둘 다 TAG_INT/FLOAT) 일 때만 `rt_add_native` 위임(rt_add_native 는 스칼라 numeric 만 봄), array-concat + to_string/concat 는 `rt_add_slow`(hexa-source) 폴백, **C `#else` 본문 RETAIN**(no-seed fallback). `tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a::resolve_native_valop_core_seed` 시드 globl 카운트 3→4(`rt_add_native` 추가 — 시드가 4/4 export 할 때만 native 채택, 미regen 시 3/3 → C 폴백 = 빌드 무해). `tool/regen_valop_core_native_s.sh` SYMS 4개로 갱신. **self-host≠release ABSOLUTE 준수**: 기본 CPU 빌드 무회귀(시드 4/4 전엔 C add 그대로). 시드 .s 3타깃 regen(aiden/summer) + focused micro-byteeq(native rt_add_native == C scalar add) + byteeq 3타깃 GREEN(PR CI 권위) 후 머지. **NEXT(sh-val-core r2)**: `hexa_div`(`__raw_idiv`/0-가드 — sub/mul 보다 조심 필요) 또는 패밀리 EXHAUST 판정(hexa_cmp 는 rt_cmp 재진입 위험·hexa_eq 는 이미 hexa-source rt_eq_int/float/bool 포팅됨 = valop-seed 클래스 아님).

title: docs(fleet-full c r2 impl): GC64 NaN-box 8B HexaVal = MEASURED-INFEASIBLE 🧱 (full-64 i64 in byteeq closure; LuaJIT ref exactly reproduced)
body: Implement-phase re-run of the #4119 value-layout research (the T3 reopen path: 'i64→i47 narrow felt-default 수용 시 LuaJIT GC64 재구동'). The LuaJIT GC64 reference is now EXACTLY REPRODUCED from src/lj_obj.h v2.1 (Mike Pall): 13-bit NaN signal | 4-bit itype (it64>>47) | 47-bit payload (LJ_GCVMASK=(1<<47)-1 = pointer|zext-32bit-int|all-1); ordinary double = bare native IEEE-754 (zero-overhead). CRUX from the reference: LuaJIT integers are 32-bit (setintV: o->i=(uint32_t)i, zero-extended) — the 47-bit field is for POINTERS; large/64-bit ints are carried as doubles (LJ_TNUMX, exact only within f64 53-bit mantissa) or heap-boxed FFI int64_t cdata OUTSIDE the NaN-box. LuaJIT has NO unboxed 64-bit integer in a TValue. MEASURED i47 ceiling against the hexa self-host byteeq closure (compiler/main.hexa imports codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa:49-50): (1) compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa:1586 'let imin: i64 = 1 << 63' (INT64_MIN 0x8000000000000000, bit 63) — float sign-flip/int-min, IN closure; (2) 74 float_to_bits/bits_to_float sites (e.g. x86_64_linux.hexa:1127,2277) materialize the FULL-64 IEEE-754 bit pattern as a TAG_INT HexaVal (codegen 2974-2975), runs every compilation, bits 47..63 set for negative/large-exp doubles → i47 truncates; (3) FNV-64 offset basis 14695981039346656037 (0xCBF29CE484222325) measured >2^53 by 1631× — unrepresentable in 47-bit, in LuaJIT's 32-bit slot, OR exactly as f64. Honest nuance: hot hash path (map_core/intern_core) is 32-bit FNV uint32_t + emerge.hexa masks &0xffffffff — those WOULD fit 47b; killers are narrower but unavoidable (1<<63 + 74 float-bit sites + user-facing exact-i64 contract). WHY LuaJIT fits 8B and hexa cannot: Lua number is double-first w/ no exact-i64 guarantee; hexa i64 is an exact 64-bit type. The GC64 tradeoff (int=i32, big-int=f64/heap-cdata) is SEMANTICALLY INCOMPATIBLE with hexa's i64 contract — the 정답지 itself does not solve full-64 i64 in 8B, it sidesteps it by not having the type. cache-density lever (the only honest 8B win, stride 16→8) is ALREADY delivered byteeq-neutrally AND correctly by HEXA_PACK_ARRAY (x86_64_linux.hexa:1328-1430, typed-prim raw-packed HexaArrI64/F64, NO tag, NO NaN-signal — strictly denser than a NaN-box's 17-bit signal+itype overhead, keeps i64 full-width) + farr32/farr64 (#3641/#3643). NO HEXA_NANBOX flag emitted (anti-filler): a flag cannot be byteeq-neutral by construction — flag-ON the compiler compiling its own 1<<63/float_to_bits emits 47-bit-truncated → gen3≡gen4 cannot hold under self-compile; the ceiling is at the type-semantics layer, so a demonstrating flag is a miscompiling flag = declined. VERDICT 🧱 general 16B→8B NaN-box MEASURED-INFEASIBLE (sharpens #4119 from assumed→measured), reopen only if hexa drops exact-i64 (it will not). doc-only: state/rfc_value_unbox_layout.md + .gitignore negation. NO compiler/seed/codegen/ARCHITECTURE.json edit. DEFAULT byteeq 3-target untouched (no source change → gen3≡gen4 trivially preserved). No build (mini=git/gh; conclusion is type-semantics + ref-match, not a measured perf delta).

title: cuda asset auto-link (#3723)
body:
- **fix(cuda): cuda asset 이 install marker 로 cudart/cublas 자동 링크** — cuda asset
  (runtime.a=cuBLAS build, #3716)을 받은 consumer 가 `hexa run/build` 시 매번
  `HEXA_CUDA=1` 을 줘야만 `-lcudart -lcublas` 가 링크되던 결함(#3723 v6b: GPU pod 에서
  runtime_cuda.o 의 cudaLaunchKernel/cublas undefined reference) 근본수정. `self/main.hexa`
  os_clang_ldflags 의 cuda gate 를 `HEXA_CUDA==1 OR $HX_HOME/.cuda-runtime marker`(HEXA_CUDA=0
  hard opt-out 유지, CUDA_HOME 없으면 /usr/local/cuda fallback)로 확장 + `install.sh` 가
  cuda asset 설치 시 marker 생성(CPU/musl 설치 시 제거, 멱등). CPU 설치/소스빌드엔 marker
  없음 → byte-identical(self-host ≠ release, byteeq NEUTRAL).


- **fix(fold-gate): dt_erf golden RE-PIN — native string→f64 parse (#3689) = correctly-rounded · OP-138 mislabel 정정**: `nobaseline-gate` 의 OP-34 fold 게이트(`tool/fold_ci_gate.sh`)가 #3689(`HEXA_RT_NUM_PARSE_FLOAT_NATIVE` default-ON)에서 GELUFWD-DET-bits drift(golden `1088281529475491513` vs native `6336059440709859003`)로 RED. **근본원인(c1 white-box, golden-STALE — misround 아님)**: OP-34 게이트는 오라클을 `hexa run`=**NATIVE-EMIT 경로**로 돌리는데, 이 경로는 float 리터럴을 컴파일러 런타임 `to_float` 로 굽는다(`compiler/lower/hir_to_mir.hexa:891` `to_float(e.text)` → emit `compiler/emit/macho_arm64.hexa:2466` `float_to_bits(to_float(f.text))` · `compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa:800,1162` `float_to_bits(o.float_val)`). seed OFF 일 때 그 `to_float` = naive `hxlcl_atof`/`rt_str_parse_float`(자릿수 누산기, NOT correctly-rounded) → GELU 경로 6개 상수를 strtod 대비 1 ULP off(`0.254829592 0.284496736 1.421413741 1.061405429` dt_erf 계수 · `0.70710678118654752440`=1/√2 · `0.01`=_fill). **OP-138 re-pin 은 이 게이트가 OP-37/40 float-fix 의 수혜를 받는다 가정해 golden 을 "compiler-correct" 로 라벨했으나 그것은 오라클 미실행 추론(F-OP138 §5 자인)이었고 실제로는 naive-atof artifact** — OP-37/40 은 C-transpile/comptime-fold serialize 만 고쳤고 native-emit `to_float(f.text)` 사이트는 마지막 naive-atof 잔존지였다. #3689 이 그 사이트를 `rt_parse_float_native`(Clinger fast-path = strtod, correctly-rounded — per-const `native==strtod` bit-for-bit 증명)로 라우팅 → dt_erf 가 **진짜 correctly-rounded 값**으로 fold: GELUFWD-DET `6336059440709859003` · GELUBWD-DET `3837435693766553512`. **이것은 correctness re-pin**(stale 오답 기준을 correctly-rounded invariant 로 정정 · seed 제거/tune-to-green 아님)이며, CEBWD(dt_exp)는 무변(상수 `0.25/1.0/2.0/12` 가 naive·strtod 동일 반올림). **검증(c2)**: summer(linux-x86_64) 격리 worktree 에서 #3689 native-ON 빌드 → `tool/fold_ci_gate.sh` 실측 = 세 fold 전부 새 golden 과 일치 PASS(GELUFWD-TAYLOR 도 동일값 6336…=내부일관). 3-platform byte-identical 은 const-fold 가 compile-time+libm-free 라 platform-independent(GELUFWD 는 3타깃 결정적 기측정) — PR CI nobaseline 3타깃이 권위. self-host≠release 준수.

- **fix(release): `-cuda` 빌드 `libcuda.so.1` 부트스트랩 벽 — DUAL-RUNTIME(CPU 툴체인 + CUDA 소비자 아카이브) 근본수정 (#3701 r2)**: #3713(frozen seed)이 stale-runner 트랩을 풀자 다음 층 벽 노출 — edge run `27860639944` -cuda job 이 **여전히 FAILURE**(frozen seed 는 GREEN 확인: "using checked-in frozen seed → built runtime_cuda.o + runtime_cuda_dlink.o (sm_75) → folding into runtime.a"). 새 실패(로그 캡처): `Stage 0 — compile self-hosted transpiler (hexa_v2)` 에서 `./build/hexa_v2: error while loading shared libraries: libcuda.so.1: cannot open shared object file` → **exit 127**. **근본원인(c1)**: 단일-아카이브 빌드가 `-DHEXA_CUDA` 를 **모든 스테이지가 공유하는 하나의 runtime.a** 에 fold → 그 runtime.a 로 링크된 부트스트랩 컴파일러(hexat/hexa_v2/hexa 드라이버)가 **libcuda.so.1 을 DT_NEEDED 로 하드링크**. self-host seed-converge/regen + Stage 0 가 그 hexa_v2 를 **실행**하는데 GPU-less CI 빌드호스트엔 NVIDIA 드라이버(libcuda.so.1)가 없어 동적로더가 죽음(exit 127). **단순 `-lcuda` strip 으론 불충분(측정)**: `runtime.c` 의 `hexa_farr_matmul` 이 `-DHEXA_CUDA` 컴파일 시 `extern _hx_cuda_farr_matmul_gpu`(self/runtime.c:8259) 를 CALL → 링커가 `runtime_cuda.o` 를 끌어옴 → cuBLAS/libcuda 필요 → 드롭하면 undefined symbol. 즉 `runtime.o` 자체가 툴체인용으론 non-CUDA 빌드여야 함. #3696(-lcuda link-time stub)은 link 만 해결, **run-time soname 은 별개 층**. **수정(c1, ⓐ — 자기빌드에 GPU dep 안 섞음)**: DUAL-RUNTIME. `stage_resolve_runtime_a::build_runtime_a_from_source` 가 ⓐ 기본 `build/runtime.a` = **CPU 아카이브**(runtime.o `-DHEXA_CUDA` 없이, cuda objects 없음 — 툴체인 전부 이걸 링크 → libcuda-free → GPU-less 호스트서 hexa_v2 실행됨) ⓑ HEXA_CUDA=1 일 때 **별도** `build/runtime.cuda.a`(runtime.o `-DHEXA_CUDA -I$cinc` + runtime_cuda.o + runtime_cuda_dlink.o)를 추가 빌드. `stage_precompile_package` 가 소비자 tarball 의 `build/runtime.a` 로 `runtime.cuda.a` 를 **swap**(소비자 `hexa build`/`run` 는 cuBLAS 링크; 호스트 cuBLAS libs 는 소비자 GPU 호스트의 os_clang_ldflags HEXA_CUDA 브랜치가 추가 — libcuda.so.1 존재). `release.yml` -cuda job LIBS = **CPU-only `-lm -ldl`**(cuBLAS strip — 파이프라인 어떤 바이너리도 cuBLAS 링크 안 함 → libcuda DT_NEEDED 0), CUDA_HOME 은 소비자-아카이브 runtime.c `-DHEXA_CUDA` 컴파일의 cublas_v2.h/cuda_runtime.h 헤더용으로 유지. Verify step 을 **dual-runtime 단언**으로 전환: 출하 runtime.a 는 cuda objects 보유(swap 확인) AND **hexa 드라이버 바이너리는 libcuda-FREE**(ldd 에 cuda/cublas 없음 — 회귀 시 fail-loud). **무회귀(self-host≠release ABSOLUTE)**: 기본(non-CUDA) 빌드는 cuda arm 미진입 = 단일 CPU runtime.a 그대로(byte 무변). -cuda 는 여전히 prerelease·finalize.needs 제외(additive). **검증**: stage_resolve_runtime_a·stage_precompile_package bash `-n` PASS · release.yml YAML PASS · build/ gitignored(runtime.cuda.a 미커밋). 머지 후 edge -cuda job GREEN → `hexa-linux-x86_64-cuda.tar.gz` 실제 출하 + 소비자 runtime.a=cuda·드라이버=libcuda-free 확인(CI), GPU cuda_available()=1 은 aiden #3680 권위.
- **fix(codegen arm64): `br_cond` INLINE-TRUTHY — `bl hexa_truthy` 제거 → valop-core native seed 3타깃 default-ON (sh-val-core r2)**: #3704 의 value-op 스칼라 native seed 가 arm64 만 C-fallback 으로 남았던 근본원인을 codegen 에서 root-fix. **근본원인(c1)**: arm64 `_STMT_BR_COND`(`compiler/codegen/arm64_darwin.hexa`)가 `if <bool-HexaVal>` 분기를 `bl hexa_truthy` 로 lower → valop seed(`self/native/valop_core_arm64.s`)의 `rt_truthy_native` 본문 자체가 6× `bl _hexa_truthy` 를 담음. seed default-ON 시 `hexa_truthy`(runtime)가 `rt_truthy_native` 로 위임(`runtime_core_emit.hexa`)되어 **무한재귀 → 스택오버플로 → SIGSEGV**(hexa_v2 self-host, qemu-aarch64 MEASURED). x86_64 는 `_STMT_BR_COND` 가 payload 를 직접 `test cond; jz` 로 INLINE(`x86_64_linux.hexa`) → seed 에 call 0개 → 재귀 없음. **수정**: arm64 br_cond 를 x86_64 와 동일하게 inline — `_hv_load` 후 payload 워드를 `cbz x1, else` 로 직접 분기(branch cond 는 항상 TAG_BOOL/TAG_INT 라 payload-nonzero == truthy, x86_64 가 이미 GREEN 출하하는 동일 semantics). seed 를 fixed codegen 으로 재생성하면 `bl hexa_truthy` 0개 → 재귀 소멸. `tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a` 의 arm64 early-return 제거 → darwin-arm64/linux-arm64 도 native scalar value-op 채택. **[self-host ≠ release] 가드**: byteeq 3타깃 + miscompile-zero GREEN + 출하 smoke 통과로만 머지.

- chore(inbox): inbox/ 폴더 폐기 — 3건 진단 전부 ING 이관 완료 (cuda-cpu-only→#8 #3680해결 · cloud-rent→#10 #3691해결 · gen3 obj-emit segfault→신규 ING #3709). per-repo INBOX 도메인은 sidecar handoff 레지스트리로 retire(거버넌스 SSOT 단일화), 진단 추적은 ING ref 단일 표면. 원본 진단 본문은 git 이력에 보존.
- **fix(release): `-cuda` 자산 stable 미출하 근본수정 — `runtime_cuda.c`/`runtime_bf16.c` 를 FROZEN SEED 로 체크인 (stale-runner chicken-egg 제거 · #3701)**: #3680(CUDA 빌드 실증)·#3682(-cuda job)·#3694(apt)·#3696/#3707(-lcuda stub)·#3709(gen3 deep-spine SIGSEGV) 인프라가 전부 머지됐음에도 **소비자 stable 릴리스 자산에 `hexa-linux-x86_64-cuda.tar.gz` 가 없었다**(v0.245.2·v0.245.3-cudafix1 = 일반 5자산만). **근본원인(c1, 릴리스 run 27851684786/27856930421 로그 캡처)**: `-cuda` job 의 build/package 는 성공하나 **"Verify CUDA fold" step 이 실패** — `runtime.a` 에 `runtime_cuda.o`/`runtime_cuda_dlink.o` 부재. 더 깊은 원인 = `tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a::resolve_cuda_runtime_seed` 의 로그 `CUDA-R1: WARN runtime_cuda.c not emitted (runner failed?)`. resolve 는 **Stage 0b** 에서 도는데(build/hexat 빌드는 Stage 0a-pre — 이후), 그 시점 emit-runner 는 **이전에 발행된 STALE edge 바이너리**뿐(`hexa-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` 다운로드). stale 바이너리의 native-run fast-path 가 7004줄 `runtime_cuda_emit.hexa`(본문 ~7000 `+` 좌편향 스파인) 를 돌릴 때 333KB C 텍스트를 쓰기 전 SIGSEGV → 파일 미생성 → nvcc fold 스킵 → -cuda 자산 무발행(self-host≠release 가 옳게 동작해 일반 stable 은 무회귀였으나 -cuda 만 영구 누락 = chicken-egg/stale-prebuilt 트랩). #3709 가 emit 세그폴트를 고쳤어도 CI 가 stale runner 를 쓰는 한 자가치유 불가. **수정(c1, root — runner 의존 제거)**: ⓐ emitter 출력 `self/cuda/runtime_cuda.c`(333959B, `_hx_dt_exp_dev` 단일 def 확인)+`runtime_bf16.c`(37593B)를 **DETERMINISTIC**(byte-eq 재-emit 2회 확인)임을 검증 후 `.gitignore` 에서 빼 **체크인**(프로즌 시드 — `restore_frozen_seeds` 20-시드 철학과 동형). ⓑ `resolve_cuda_runtime_seed` 를 **frozen-seed-first** 로 — 체크인된 `runtime_cuda.c` 가 present + `_hx_dt_exp_dev`=1 이면 runner emit **스킵**(stale-runner-immune), 부재/regress 시에만 기존 runner-emit 폴백(로컬 emitter 편집 후 재생성 경로 유지). nvcc fold 는 resolve 내부서 즉시 그 시드로 진행. ⓒ `install.sh prefer_cuda()` 를 **GPU auto-detect** 로 확장 — `HEXA_CUDA=1` 강제/`=0` 옵트아웃 외에 unset(auto)면 `nvidia-smi -L` GPU **AND** 해소가능 cuBLAS/cudart 런타임(ldconfig/표준 CUDA lib dir) 둘 다일 때 `-cuda` 자산 선호(GPU 소비자 install 이 opt-in 없이 cuda_available()=1). 둘 다 요구 = cudart 없는 GPU 호스트에 cuBLAS-링크 바이너리 출하 회피(그땐 CPU 자산 유지). edge-보조 자산이라 부재 시 기존 generic 폴백이 CPU glibc 로 자동복귀(install 무하드페일). **자산 네이밍·finalize 무변경**: `-cuda` 는 여전히 prerelease·make_latest:false·finalize.needs 제외(additive opt-in — -cuda 실패가 stable 3-green 승격을 절대 안 막음, self-host≠release ABSOLUTE 준수). **검증**: stage_resolve_runtime_a·install.sh bash `-n` PASS · 시드 byte-eq 재-emit 2회 일치 · frozen-seed 분기 검출 시뮬레이션 OK(ndef=1→FROZEN branch). 다음 edge/stable 릴리스의 -cuda job 이 stale runner 없이 GREEN → `hexa-linux-x86_64-cuda.tar.gz` 실제 출하(CI `ar t` fold 검증 + `ldd` cuBLAS; GPU `cuda_available()=1` 은 aiden #3680 권위). 시드 regen 규율: emitter 편집 후 `hexa run self/cuda/runtime_cuda_emit.hexa self/cuda/runtime_cuda.c`(+bf16) → commit.
- chore(inbox): inbox/ 폴더 폐기 — 3건 진단 전부 ING 이관 완료 (cuda-cpu-only→#8 #3680해결 · cloud-rent→#10 #3691해결 · gen3 obj-emit segfault→신규 ING #3709). per-repo INBOX 도메인은 sidecar handoff 레지스트리로 retire(거버넌스 SSOT 단일화), 진단 추적은 ING ref 단일 표면. 원본 진단 본문은 git 이력에 보존. (cuda-cpu-only→#8 #3680해결 · cloud-rent→#10 #3691해결 · gen3 obj-emit segfault→신규 ING #3709). per-repo INBOX 도메인은 sidecar handoff 레지스트리로 retire(거버넌스 SSOT 단일화), 진단 추적은 ING ref 단일 표면. 원본 진단 본문은 git 이력에 보존.

- **fix(lower): gen3 obj-emit SIGSEGV — `_lower_expr`/`_lower_hexpr` deep left-spine 재귀 stack overflow → iterative flatten (#3709)**: release `-cuda` 잡의 `runtime_cuda.c not emitted` 근본 = gen3 self-host 컴파일러가 `self/cuda/runtime_cuda_emit.hexa`(단일 7004줄 fn, 본문이 `let s = "…" + "…" + …` ~7000개 `+`)를 `--emit=obj` 할 때 **자기 네이티브 스택을 overflow** 하며 SIGSEGV. **근본원인(c1, aiden gdb 격리 — EXIT=139)**: 파서 precedence-climbing(`parse_additive`/`_multiplicative`)이 same-op run 을 **LEFT-LEANING** 트리(`a+b+c+…` → `((a+b)+c)…`)로 빌드 → 모든 binop 의 `child[0]`가 체인 끝까지 binop. AST→HIR 의 `_lower_expr`(`compiler/lower/ast_to_hir.hexa:1607`)가 `child[0]`로 ~7000프레임 재귀 → gen3 자기 스택 붕괴. gdb bt: `#0..#N` 전부 `_lower_expr` 동일 self-call 주소, `rsp` 스택바닥 이탈, `rbp=0x6` garbage(전형적 stack overflow). 소형 프로그램 RC=0 정상, 깊은 스파인만 죽음. **`_lower_expr` 만 고치면 불충분(측정)**: AST→HIR 가 안 죽자 HIR→MIR 의 `_lower_hexpr`(`hir_to_mir.hexa:1071`, 같은 `child[0]` 재귀)가 이어받아 — _lower_expr-only 바이너리는 크래시 없이 **4.5분+ 100% CPU**(깊은 재귀 + per-node `_lr_locals` churn)로 7000-`+` 파일을 끝내지 못함(275s서 kill). 깊은-스파인 취약성은 **모든 재귀 expr walker 에 걸친 클래스**. **수정(전략 ⓐ iterative flatten, 릴리스-safe — 런타임/ABI/스택 무변경)**: `_lower_expr`+`_lower_hexpr` 둘 다 `child[0]` 스파인을 explicit worklist 로 내려가 base 1회 lower 후 bottom-up 재구성 — HExpr 트리 모양·스코프 좌→우 threading(_lower_expr)·STMT_BINOP post-order 방출·`_lr_locals` 변이·ctx threading(_lower_hexpr) 원본 재귀와 **IDENTICAL**, native 스택깊이 O(1). **byte-eq 무회귀 보장**: 두 flatten 은 **depth>1000 임계 가드**(`_hir_lower_binop_spine_deep`/`_hir_binop_left_spine_deep`) 뒤에 격리 — 임계 미만(모든 손작성 코드)은 **원본 재귀 arm 그대로** 실행, 임계 초과(생성된 7000-`+` 같은 병리적 체인 = 재귀가 어차피 크래시/행, 위반할 baseline 부재)만 iterative. **#3704 와 다른 버그**(#3704 = arm64 RUNTIME 크래시: 컴파일된 프로그램 실행시 `bl hexa_truthy` br_cond 패턴 스택소진; #3709 = 컴파일러 COMPILE-time 깊은 AST 자기 스택 overflow, x86_64서도 발생 — 함수·단계·아키텍처·트리거 전부 상이). type-check(`_infer_expr`/`_types_check_binop`)도 같은 스파인 재귀지만 gdb상 x86_64서 7000-deep 생존(프레임 작음) → blast radius 최소화 위해 재귀 유지(정직한 잔여 — 더 깊은 파일/작은-스택 타깃서 크래시하면 r2). byteeq 3타깃 GREEN(CI) + 출하 smoke 통과 후 머지(self-host≠release ABSOLUTE).

- **feat(self-host array): alloc-bearing `hexa_array_arena_alloc_items` → 네이티브 아레나 포팅 (sh-array-write · "alloc is NOT a wall" 입증)**: 이전 array 레인(#3666)은 `new`/`push`/`reserve` 를 "alloc=WALL-2 libc floor" 로 마킹했으나 이는 **틀린 진단**이었다 — 할당기는 **이미 네이티브**(`self/rt/alloc.hexa::hexa_arena_alloc` → 프로즌 시드 `self/native/alloc_syscall_*.s`, `HEXA_RT_ALLOC_NATIVE` 기본 ON, C 아레나는 `#else` 로 demote). 따라서 array 모듈에서 **arena 를 호출하는 유일한 alloc 헬퍼**인 `hexa_array_arena_alloc_items`(grow path 의 `hexa_arena_alloc(n*sizeof(HexaVal))`)는 libc 벽이 아니라 **다음 포팅 증분**이다. **포팅(c1, 근본까지)**: `stdlib/runtime/array_core.hexa::rt_array_arena_alloc_items_native(n)` = `n*16`(sizeof(HexaVal)) 바이트를 **이미-네이티브 아레나에서** `extern fn hexa_arena_alloc` 로 할당(raw-ptr 반환). native→native 엣지라 C 브리지 불필요(둘 다 aprime_cc 컴파일 → HexaVal 2-register ABI 일치; `__hxseed_arena_alloc` C 브리지는 C 호출자 전용). C `hexa_array_arena_alloc_items` 는 `#ifdef HEXA_RT_ARRAY_ARENA_NATIVE` 로 위임 — 게이트(`hexa_array_arena_on` + `__hexa_val_mark_top` live-mark + NULL→malloc fallback)는 C-side 유지(read-half guard-C / body-native 분할과 동형), **C `#else` 보존**(standalone smoke + `HEXA_RT_ALLOC_NATIVE=0` revert). `stage_resolve_runtime_a` 는 **array 시드 AND alloc 시드 둘 다 네이티브일 때만** `HEXA_RT_ARRAY_ARENA_NATIVE=1` 정의. **남은 벽(정직한 🧱)**: `new()` 의 `calloc` + `push()` 의 `realloc` grow-branch 는 C 유지 — 네이티브 malloc/calloc 시드가 **부재**(아레나만 네이티브)하므로 개별-free 영속 힙은 시드가 표현 불가, **arena bump path 만** 포팅됨. **검증(c2, aiden 실측 캡처)**: ⓐ 3타깃 시드 regen(darwin-arm64·linux-x86_64·linux-arm64) 각 **7 globl**(read-half 6 + arena bridge 1), x86_64 cross-assemble `7 globl · 7 T`, `T rt_array_arena_alloc_items_native` + `U hexa_arena_alloc`(`call hexa_arena_alloc` 1) — **alloc-bearing prim 이 네이티브 시드로 클린 lower** 확인. ⓑ focused arena byte-eq(array+alloc 시드만 링크): 신선 아레나에서 `rt_array_arena_alloc_items_native(40)` 소비 바이트 = `hexa_arena_alloc(40*16)` = `align_up(640,8)=640` **일치**, 40개 HexaVal write+read roundtrip **byte-Δ=0** → `MICRO_BYTEEQ_OK native-arena-bridge == C-arena-alloc`. ⓒ runtime.c 양 `#ifdef` arm 클린 컴파일(ON=arena bridge 참조 1 · OFF=C body 참조 0). **결론: alloc-bearing prim 은 `hexa_arena_alloc` 를 호출하는 네이티브 시드로 깨끗이 포팅된다 = alloc 은 libc 벽이 아님(zero-C closure 전진).** 3타깃 byteeq GREEN(CI) 후 머지 · C `#else` 보존(self-host≠release ABSOLUTE).

QFORGE-shape 재현(H_apply 클로저+packed ψ, Rayleigh): OLD=`(tag 1 * tag 24)`→NEW=`3.0`. emit 차이=배열 `a`/`b` 가 `hexa_arr_f64_new`(packed)→`hexa_array_new`/`hexa_array_push`(boxed)로 전환(딱 저장소 결정만). 무회귀: 무-escape 케이스(로컬 element-read만)는 OLD/NEW emit **byte-identical**(packed 결정 불변, 결과 30.0). env-hatch `HEXA_NATIVE_ARR=1`+escape 는 잔존 수동-opt-in 위험(플래그 OFF 인 blocker 와 무관·코멘트로 표기). byteeq 3타깃 무회귀=PR CI 권위.

Files: compiler/check/types.hexa (`else if _types_is_ident||_types_is_call` arm in the local-Let case of _infer_expr, reusing _types_kind_is_scalar + _types_assignable + _emit_hx3011 from r1), compiler/check/types_test.hexa (self-adapting case (i): flag-ON asserts 2 HX3011 = ident param + call return, default asserts 0 = byteeq-neutral proof). Stacks on r1 (PR #4094, unmerged at branch time). Next rung r3 = let-without-`=` then later assign (decl/init split).

- **Wall A static-types r3 (opt-in REJECT decl/init-split assign mismatch)** — extends the local static-type slice to the decl/init split: a `let x: T` with NO initializer, then a LATER `x = <expr>` assignment in the same block whose inferred scalar RHS provably disagrees with the recorded declaration T emits FATAL HX3011 'mismatched types' (Rust E0308; rustc_hir_typeck/src/expr.rs check_expr_assign → demand_coerce_diag → report_mismatched_types — the assignment sibling of the path r1/r2 mirror). Still default-OFF via HEXA_STATIC_TYPES=1 and byteeq-neutral (every new branch is env-gated → default diagnostic stream byte-identical → gen3=gen4 fixpoint untouched). Mechanism: the Block case of _infer_expr now threads a block-scoped env (`benv`, only re-bound under the flag) that records each annotated `let x: T`'s declared KNOWN-scalar type under the binding name (mirror helper _types_let_name = bind.hexa:_bind_let_name); the Assign case looks the LHS ident's declared type up and, when BOTH the declared LHS and inferred RHS are known scalar primitives and provably non-assignable, emits HX3011 and SUPPRESSES the generic HX3001 (r3_rejected) so one mistake = one error. `let x: i32; x = "s"` and `let y: string; y = 5` REJECT; `let z: i32; z = 7` (int-lit coercion) stays clean. Same r1/r2 soundness gates: unknown idents (empty kind), unit, HexaVal and aggregates skipped (r5+) → no false REJECT. No new keyword/builtin/@attr → frozen seed 151c52c8 untouched. Files: compiler/check/types.hexa (_types_let_name helper + benv-threading in the Block case + r3 arm in the Assign case of _infer_expr), compiler/check/types_test.hexa (_let_decl_expr/_assign_expr helpers + self-adapting case (j): flag-ON asserts 2 HX3011, default asserts 0 = byteeq-neutral proof). Stacks on r1 (PR #4094) + r2 (PR #4102), unmerged at branch time. Next rung r4 = range/array index-fit OR struct field-type assign mismatch.

- **Wall A static-types r4 (opt-in REJECT array element-fit assign mismatch)** — extends the local static-type slice to AGGREGATE element-fit: a `let a: [i32; N]` (or unsized `[i32]`) recorded its KNOWN-scalar element type, then a LATER `a[i] = <expr>` index-assign whose inferred scalar RHS provably disagrees with that element type emits FATAL HX3011 'mismatched types' (Rust E0308; rustc_hir_typeck/src/expr.rs check_expr_index place-coercion -> demand_coerce -> report_mismatched_types -- the index-place sibling of the assign path r3 mirrors). Still default-OFF via HEXA_STATIC_TYPES=1 and byteeq-neutral (every new branch env-gated -> default diagnostic stream byte-identical -> gen3=gen4 fixpoint untouched). Mechanism: the parser encodes `[T; N]`/`[T]` as the annotation type-name `Array:<elem>[:<N>]` (parser.hexa:parse_type, RFC 085); the Block case of _infer_expr now also records the array's element type (new helper _types_array_elem_kind, mirror of hir_to_mir _arru_array_type_id_from_text split) under a COLLISION-FREE env key `[]<name>` (an identifier can never start with `[`, so the whole-array ident lookup of `a` is never shadowed -> zero pollution); the Assign case, when the LHS is an Index node whose base is a plain ident, looks the recorded element type up and -- when BOTH the element type and inferred RHS are known scalar primitives and provably non-assignable -- emits HX3011 and SUPPRESSES the generic HX3001 (r3_rejected). `let a:[i32;4]; a[0]="s"` and `let b:[string]; b[1]=9` REJECT; `let c:[i32;4]; c[2]=7` (int-lit coercion) stays clean. Struct field-type fit (`s.field = expr`) deferred to r5. Same soundness gates: count-only `Array:<N>`, unknown/nested-array/struct elements and unknown RHS skipped (r5+) -> no false REJECT. No new keyword/builtin/@attr (new helpers are .chars()-based, no new Index@attr) -> frozen seed 151c52c8 untouched. Stacks on r1 (PR #4094) + r2 (PR #4102) + r3 (PR #4104), unmerged at branch time. Next rung r5 = struct field-type assign mismatch (`s.x = expr` when field x's type is known).

- **Wall A static-types r5 (opt-in REJECT struct field-type assign mismatch)** — extends the local static-type slice to STRUCT field-fit: with `struct Point { x: i32, y: i32 }`, a `s.field = <expr>` field-assign whose inferred scalar RHS provably disagrees with field's declared type emits FATAL HX3011 'mismatched types' (Rust E0308; rustc_hir_typeck/src/expr.rs check_field place-coercion -> demand_coerce -> report_mismatched_types -- the field-place sibling of the index path r4 mirrors). Still default-OFF via HEXA_STATIC_TYPES=1 and byteeq-neutral (every new branch env-gated -> default diagnostic stream byte-identical -> gen3=gen4 fixpoint untouched). MEASUREMENT: the env's struct binding (Type{kind=struct, args=[field types]}) keeps field types in declaration order but DROPS field NAMES, and the Module (sole carrier of struct.params[i].name) is NOT in _infer_expr scope (CheckCtx holds only fn_name/fn_return/module) -- so the field name->type map is unrecoverable from the env alone. Resolved by mirroring the EXISTING enum-payload side registry exactly: _types_register_struct_item_fields populates module-global parallel arrays (field names + named-type spellings) at _collect_item_types time (struct Item in scope, AFTER the cross-file collision continue), queryable by (struct_name, field_name) at the assign site; reset per type_check() call alongside the enum registry; populated unconditionally (pure data, no diagnostic) but READ only under the flag -> byte-neutral default. The receiver's struct name is recovered two ways: a block-local `let s: Point` lowers to kind named:Point and is recorded under a COLLISION-FREE env key `{}<name>` (an ident can never start with `{`); a fn PARAM `p: Point` / module-let carries its named:Point type directly (bound by _types_bind_params/_collect_item_types), re-inferred into a SCRATCH sink (no double-report). `_types_struct_name_of` strips the named: prefix (.chars()-based, no new builtin). Same soundness gates: non-struct receivers, unknown/non-named/non-scalar field types, unknown RHS all skipped -> no false REJECT. No new keyword/builtin/@attr -> frozen seed 151c52c8 untouched. title: bench(game-thread r1): MEASURED baseline on aiden (real OS threads) + bottleneck attribution
body: Built test/game_thread_microbench.hexa thread-enabled on aiden (12-core x86_64): native-emit (hexa_clock=CLOCK_MONOTONIC wall-clock) linked against a runtime compiled -DHEXA_THREADS (gcc -O2, real pthread_create/join + C11 _Atomic cells + -lpthread). BUILD GOTCHA closed: in-tree self/runtime.c + self/native/thread.c were STALE — the #if defined(HEXA_THREADS) real-pthread block and atomic_cell_* block live only in the emitter SSOTs (runtime_emit_full.hexa, thread_emit.hexa) and had never been regenerated; a first build silently linked the SYNCHRONOUS #else shims (rt_pthread_noop -> fake 25ns/spawn, flat p-scaling). Regenerating both .c from emitters first gave real threads (nm: U pthread_create@GLIBC; lane d scales 1.99x/3.41x/4.73x). MEDIANS (3 runs): (a) spawn/join 7.60us/thread; (b) channel 40.1M msg/s (~25ns uncontended); (c) atomic on one shared cell K1 174.9M->K8 100.2M ops/s (aggregate CAPS, sum_ok=true — cache-line MESI contention, does NOT scale); (d) N-thread scale p2 1.99x/p4 3.41x/p8 4.73x (eff 0.996/0.85/0.59, p8 confounded by bg load); (e) boxed/raw 4.61x. ATTRIBUTION (measure-first): (a)/(b) ADEQUATE at game-frame scale (thread-pool NOT warranted — 7.6us x realistic worker counts << 16.6ms budget); MEASURED WALLS = (e) boxing 4.61x (broadest, codegen native-unbox lever) + (c) single-atomic non-scaling (sharded-counter lever, only if a real workload has a hot cell). r4 = native-unbox job-payload (codegen, opt-in, byteeq-safe). title: feat(selfhost RFC061 Route C Wall 3-a): +7 CORE FILE* fopen/fread/fwrite/fseek/ftell/fclose/fdopen — pure compose over dissolved syscalls, no new intrinsic (default-OFF byteeq-neutral)
body: Wall 3-a dissolves the core stdio FILE* subset into stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa as native Route C C-ABI bodies. In the frozen 0-libc floor (self/runtime_emit_full.hexa:1153-1242) a FILE* is the fake pointer (void*)(uintptr_t)(fd+1) — NOT a libc stdio struct — so fopen/fread/fwrite/fseek/ftell/fclose/fdopen are a PURE COMPOSITION over the already-dissolved Route C syscall leaves (open_sys/read/write/lseek/close) + raw-payload pointer arithmetic ((fd+1) wrap = __hx_payload_add(fd,1), unwrap = __hx_payload_sub(fp,1)). ZERO new intrinsic, ZERO new @attr/keyword (frozen blob 151c52c8 untouched): 7 _is_cabi whitelist lines in compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa + 7 pure bodies. fopen maps mode strings to per-target O_* flags (Linux vs darwin values selected by target_is_linux() compile-time const, disjoint bits → ADD composes as OR) and carries the floor leak-guard (fd<=2 → NULL). fread/fwrite loop partial transfers and return the libc ITEM count (got/size), unbuffered. libc-global streams stderr/stdout/stdin (frozen _hxlcl_fp_fd v>=0x1000 branch) stay shim-resident (out of scope, fail-safe here) — follow-on via @asm + fd constants. Reference-matched body-for-body to the frozen emitter. byteeq-neutral by construction: default builds never set HEXA_CABI_HXLCL so _is_cabi returns false (dead branches) and hxlcl_core.hexa is never imported by self/ — shim.o + emitted user binaries byte-identical. Coverage: tool/routec_cabi_smoke.sh (darwin-arm64) + _linux.sh (linux-x86_64) gain a full write->close->reopen->read FILE* roundtrip with byte-exact + ftell/fseek position-exact asserts (linux also asserts O_APPEND-at-EOF for the per-target flag value). title: perf(game-thread r4): native-unbox job-payload = MEASURED WALL 🧱 (memory-layout, not call-overhead)
body: r3 attributed lane (e)'s 4.61× boxed/raw tax to {tag,payload} HexaVal boxing and named r4 = native-unbox job payload (codegen, opt-in, byteeq-safe), hypothesizing call+tag-dispatch overhead. MEASUREMENT FALSIFIES that hypothesis (aiden x86_64, fresh gate-bearing aprime_cc + native --emit=obj run route). Finding 1: the access-unbox codegen ALREADY EXISTS — HEXA_UNBOX_ARRAY_NATIVE (compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa:1113-1290, default-OFF opt-in, byteeq-safe) replaces boxed call hexa_index_get/set with an inlined HexaArr descriptor walk for provably typed-prim arrays (type_id 101..104) + provably-int index; ARRU-debug confirms it fires (gate_ok=1, 8 fast-path asm lines) on `let buf: [i64] = []`. Finding 2: it yields ZERO measurable speedup — N=2M boxed_accumulate OFF~3.3×/ON~3.4× (within noise), pure index loop N=5M OFF~2.3×/ON~2.3×. Finding 3 ROOT (file:line): the tax is 16B-HexaVal-per-element memory traffic (every slot = full {tag@+0,payload@+8}, stride 16, array_core.hexa:17; the fast-path still does imul rax,16 + mov [r11+8], x86_64_linux.hexa:1232-1237 — eliminates the call, NOT the 16B traffic = half the cache density of a packed 8B i64) + the push-half realloc grow-branch which is an explicit libc wall (array_core.hexa:23-25: calloc/realloc has NO native seed). VERDICT: closed-negative for access-unbox — NOT the Wall-A dynamic-type ceiling (types proven fine), a distinct memory-LAYOUT wall. The real escape = packed unboxed array (8B farr64/farr32, no per-elem tag), ALREADY LANDED by the read-path boxing-unbox campaign (read_f32_array_at→farr32, #3641/#3643, v0.241.9+, 522× RSS lever) → correct guidance is `use farr not []`, a stdlib/usage choice, not a codegen-unbox of []. NO code change (a native fast-push yielding 0 measured gain = filler, declined). doc-only: state/rfc_game_thread_perf.md r4 section + this entry. byteeq untouched.

title: fix(element-pack): alias-coherence fixpoint — escape lattice transitive over alias set (HEXA_PACK_ARRAY opt-in now sound)
body: Root-cause fix for the measured element-pack default-ON NO-GO (state/element-pack-default-on/RESULT.txt): with HEXA_PACK_ARRAY=1, arrays that escaped or aliased miscompiled — ka_arg_escape OFF=4096/ON=4095 (off-by-one) and kc_alias OFF=2126/ON=<value>999064 (HexaVal tag-corruption), asm-confirmed. Root: a typed-prim array lowers to two MIR locals sharing one buffer — storage T (array_lit) and handle X (let X=T, a HexaVal copy). The whole-function escape scan (compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa regmap builder) cleared the packed bit PER-LOCAL, INDEPENDENTLY, and counted op==let arg-0 as a non-escaping safe use, so it could leave one member of an aliasing pair PACKED while a sharing handle/param/alias was BOXED — a boxed (stride-16/tagged) access of a raw-packed (stride-8/untagged) buffer = layout mismatch. FIX: append an alias-coherence fixpoint pass (~L829) that iterates over every let A=B copy and voids BOTH ends whenever they straddle packed/boxed — making the V8 PACKED->HOLEY fallback TRANSITIVE over the alias set (subsumes the per-local escape void: an escaped handle X drags its storage T to boxed via the canonical let X=T, along T->X->Y chains). The pass only ever voids (tightens), never adds packing, so it cannot introduce new miscompiles; the non-aliased k3_arrmap fast path (sole both-packed let X=T) is untouched. VERIFY (aiden x86_64, fixed cc_native from origin/perf/element-pack-default-on-probe): escape-stress 9/9 ALL_BIT_EXACT (ka+kc holes CLOSED; new kg direct-alias + kh alias-then-escape PASS), PACK-ON emit byte-identical-deterministic (sha 4dca7b23, twice), ENCODE-MISS=0 on the compiler's own 2.26MB self-emit AND a mixed packed+escape+alias program (miscompile-zero), k3_arrmap 9.78x PRESERVED (still packed, ~9.3-9.7x). Honest tradeoff (no tune-to-green): the pass is conservative on direct-alias/reassign shapes (kf/kg box-both), losing packing there but not on the headline mut-array. Native x86_64-linux path only; default stays env-OFF (byteeq-neutral, OFF=zero new logic). The default-ON flip remains GATED on the 3-target gen3≡gen4 byteeq CI per release-integrity (blocked locally by pre-existing HX4001 + rt_array_*_native infra walls, orthogonal to this codegen). state/element-pack-escape-transitive/{DESIGN,RESULT}.txt.

title: doc(fleet lane s r1): static-typed unboxed value → game-concurrency wall — MEASURED wiring-gap + root-cause pivot (no code/seed edit, byteeq-neutral)
body: Lane s of the game-parity fleet (siblings: a feat/arena-threadsafe-tls TLS arena #4117 necessary-but-insufficient; c rfc_value_unbox_layout 8B NaN-box MEASURED-INFEASIBLE exact-i64 contract). User instruction 벽 먼저 해결⇒정적: don't thread-safe/8B the dynamic {tag,payload}, eliminate the box with static types. r1 = census + measurement + RFC, DOC-ONLY (no compiler/self/stdlib/seed edit). reference-match (file:line): Go interface=2-word {type,data} pair vs concrete int=raw word (research.swtch.com/interfaces); Rust dyn Trait=fat ptr {data,vtable} 2-word vs monomorphized <T>=unboxed (reference/type-layout.html#layout.trait-object, nomicon/exotic-sizes.html); C struct member=base+offset no tag (C11 §6.7.2.1p15). Invariant: static-type ⇒ raw single-word ⇒ torn-read-free by-value copy. CENSUS (does static type reach codegen): YES at IR level — HExpr.typ (hir.hexa:51) → _type_id_of (hir_to_mir.hexa:181-207, 1=i64/3=f64/101-104=[prim]) → Local/param type_id (mir.hexa:28-31, _fresh_local:457-476) → rm_local_type (x86_64_linux.hexa:641-677). BUT the four unbox flags are EPHEMERAL (HEXA_UNBOX_NATIVE binop-scope :1219-1328, HEXA_UNBOX_ARRAY_NATIVE element-load tag-preserved :1330-1443, HEXA_PACK_ARRAY :1372-1421, HEXA_TYPED_STRUCT self/codegen.hexa:5771-5789) — NO path stores a scalar local/param/return as a raw word; PAIR-MODEL (x86_64_linux.hexa:220-231, :613-623) always splits {tag,payload} across payload-spill + parallel tag-slot, param ingress 16B reg-pair (:4220-4288), return 16B rax:rdx (:4047-4070) → by-value copy = 2 non-atomic stores = torn-read-vulnerable. WIRING GAP: the static-unbox lever to close this is unwired. ROOT-CAUSE PIVOT (measured, captured gdb): the lane-a/jobpool crash is NOT scalar torn-read — it is hxlcl_realloc <- hexa_array_push <- pool_submit <- main (shared boxed-array grow racing the non-thread-safe arena; aiden 69a93f88b/ac4ed3c07), +struct→map SIGBUS. HEXA_PACK_ARRAY (the one raw-word store) is STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED — its non-escaping proof (x86_64_linux.hexa:1407-1421) voids on any call-arg/return/shared use, and a 4P+4C shared array is escaping by construction → stays BOXED. before/after: before=threaded path SIGSEGV/SIGBUS at every worker count (captured); after=NOT measurable (fix unwired AND scalar-unbox doesn't touch the allocator-race backtrace); microbench lane d static-i64 busy_worker runs crash-free only because it shares NO boxed array, NOT because locals are raw (they aren't) — a control, not a valid after. CROSS-CONFIRM: lane-a rfc_game_thread_perf.md independently converges (genuine lever = packed unboxed array, escape voids pack proof). byteeq: DEFAULT untouched (no code/seed edit, OFF-path .o byte-id by construction, gen3≡gen4 3-target unchanged, frozen 151c52c8 intact, no new keyword/builtin/@attr). 🧱 r1 verdict = static-unbox→torn-read-free is correct abstractly + static type DOES reach codegen, but (1) scalar raw-word storage-class is a substantial unwired codegen project, (2) the measured crash is the shared-array-grow allocator race which scalar-unbox doesn't address. r2 named: relax PACK_ARRAY non-escaping→escaping-typed-prim + thread-safe packed grow (shared [i64]/[f64] worker buffer = tagless 8B elements + thread-safe alloc); measure-first whether a typed-prim shared buffer (no struct/map/boxed [job,arg]) already survives 4P+4C on lane-a TLS arena BEFORE wiring. DO NOT re-run scalar-unbox microbench as r2 (non-test for this wall). state/rfc_static_unbox_thread.md.

title: fix(compiler/check/bind S1): thread/channel/atomic runtime fn-global carriers — HX2001 exemption (raw `aprime --emit` multithreaded .hexa, FLEET 잔여 #5, byteeq-neutral)
body: FLEET 잔여 #5 — #4154가 thread carrier fn-globals를 runtime.h fwd-decl로 고쳐 C-transpile/`hexa run` 멀티스레드 .hexa를 e2e 닫았으나, raw `aprime --emit` 네이티브 경로는 codegen 전에 S1 name-resolution(compiler/check/bind.hexa bind())이 bare callee `thread_spawn(f,arg)`를 미지 이름으로 보고 HX2001을 띄워 멀티스레드 .hexa가 네이티브 emit 안 됨(cf6fc2af8가 같은 이유로 escape-relax 테스트서 thread fn-global을 드롭). ROOT-CAUSE=이들은 source-level `fn` decl이 아니라 native/thread.c가 `HexaVal thread_spawn;` 같은 carrier global로 선언 후 `_hexa_init_thread_fn_shims`(thread_emit.hexa:383-398)로 런타임 등록하는 TAG_FN carrier — float_to_bits/bits_to_float 런타임 intrinsic과 정확히 같은 패턴(nanbox.hexa:223-230). FIX=_bind_builtin_names() allowlist에 carrier 8개 추가(thread_spawn·thread_join·thread_channel_new/send/recv/close + now_ms + atomic_cell_new/load/store/add/sub/cas; sleep_ms는 기존 builtin). bind는 이름만 module scope에 _define(HX2001 면제) — codegen 무영향(carrier는 _is_builtin_name/_is_known_fn_global에 없어 그대로 hexa_callN(carrier,…)으로 라우팅, codegen.hexa:8251 fallback). BYTEEQ-NEUTRAL: 이름만 scope 등록 → carrier 미참조 프로그램은 emit 바이트 불변, carrier 참조 프로그램은 현재 컴파일 자체가 안 되므로 기존 byte output 없음. before(base aprime: HX2001)/after(patched: link OK+run) aiden 실측.

title: feat(native backend): fn-ref-as-value lowering (op=fn_ref → hexa_fn_new TAG_FN) — multithreaded .hexa native-emit (FLEET 잔여 #5 r2, byteeq-neutral)
body: FLEET 잔여 #5 r2 — S1 carrier 면제(직전 커밋) 후 드러난 다음 벽. `thread_spawn(worker, 1)`에서 fn `worker`를 VALUE로 넘기면 native lower(compiler/lower/hir_to_mir.hexa `ident` 분기)가 _mir_lookup/_mir_lookup_global(로컬+ITEM_LET 글로벌만 앎·fn 이름 모름) 둘 다 실패 → HX1101 'unbound identifier in lower' fatal. native backend는 fn-ref-as-value를 지원한 적 없음. FIX=3곳: ①hir_to_mir lower_hir 진입 pre-pass로 top-level fn 이름+arity 레지스트리(_lr_fn_ref_names/_arities) 수집(선언 전 참조도 해결·extern fn 제외) ②`ident` value-position 분기에 local/global 실패 후 HX1101 전에 fn_ref 분기 추가→op='fn_ref' args=[name_str,arity_int] STMT_ASSIGN emit ③x86_64_linux+arm64_darwin codegen에 op='fn_ref'→hexa_fn_new((void*)<sym>,arity) 핸들러(closure_new 미러·x86 lea[rip+sym]→rdi·esi=arity·arm64 adrp/add @PAGE/@PAGEOFF→x0·w1=arity). CRITICAL=TAG_FN(hexa_fn_new) NOT TAG_CLOSURE(hexa_closure_new): runtime.h hexa_call1_hv가 TAG_CLOSURE에 env를 prepend(fp(closure_env,a1))→plain fn worker(start)는 env param 없어 env를 start로 오독=miscompile. TAG_FN은 fp(a1) env-prepend 없음=plain fn 시그니처 일치(C-transpile가 hexa_fn_new 쓰는 이유와 동일). BYTEEQ-NEUTRAL: fn_ref 분기는 local+global lookup 둘 다 실패한 뒤=오늘 HX1101 fatal 경로뿐→오늘 컴파일되는 모든 프로그램(컴파일러 자기소스 포함)은 이 분기 미도달→self-host fixpoint gen3≡gen4 emit 바이트 불변. before(base aprime: HX2001)→S1 fix→(HX1101)→r2 fix→after(link OK+real OS thread run) aiden 실측.

title: feat(codegen arm64 element-pack): HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING — arm64 escape-relax port (esc-mint + hexa_arr_poly_* routing, AAPCS64; opt-in default-OFF byteeq-neutral)
body: FLEET arm64 element-pack — the x86_64-only escape-relax (#4140 TAG_ARRAY_I64 descriptor + #4143/#4151 codegen esc-mint+poly-route) was a NO-OP on the arm64 backend: compiler/codegen/arm64_darwin.hexa had NO per-local type lattice (it routes everything through the boxed runtime), so an escaping typed-prim [i64] stayed boxed and #4133's ABI wall was unclosed on arm64. This ports the SAME lever in AAPCS64. CENSUS (x86_64 reference): X86RegMap.local_type + .local_packed_esc_ok lattice + _pack_escaping_enabled/_x86_operand_pack_esc/_x86_local_esc_mint gates + 5 emit boundaries (array_lit esc-mint x86_64_linux.hexa ~L2571, index poly_get ~L2810, index_set poly_set ~L2920, push poly_push ~L3985, len target-swap ~L4018) + hir_to_mir.hexa _arru_native_enabled(L214)/_arrpk_fuse_enabled(L271) element-kind stamp (already PLATFORM-AGNOSTIC, gated on HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING since #4151 → arm64 inherits the 101/102 type stamp for free). PORT (arm64_darwin.hexa): (1) RegMap += local_type + local_packed_esc_ok (both forwarded through the 2nd RegMap rebuild in _arm64_lower_func). (2) _arm_max_local_id + _arm_pack_escaping_enabled + _arm_local_type + _arm_operand_pack_esc + _arm_local_esc_mint (all `_arm_`-prefixed → no flatten-collision with x86_64's, #3899; SAME shared env flag HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING). (3) esc lattice built in _arm64_assign_regs (type-id from mf.locals/params + array_lit-storage 2-pass propagation, identical to x86_64). (4) 5 AAPCS64 emit boundaries: array_lit → hexa_arr_i64_new_esc(cap→w0, x0:x1) + per-elem hexa_arr_i64_push(v→x0:x1, raw int x→x2 = element HexaVal payload x_hi); index → hexa_arr_poly_get(v→x0:x1, raw idx→x2); index_set → hexa_arr_poly_set(v→x0:x1, raw idx→x2, item→x3:x4, store-back descriptor); push → target-swap hexa_arr_poly_push (generic builtin emit already lands v→x0:x1 item→x2:x3, identical ABI); len → target-swap hexa_arr_poly_len (identical ABI + int ret-box to hexa_len). The runtime half (TAG_ARRAY_I64 + hexa_arr_poly_*, #4140) is platform-agnostic C → the SAME runtime.a (-DHEXA_PACK_ESCAPING) serves both backends. measure harness=tool/measure_escape_relax_arm64.sh (aiden: patched aprime emits arm64-linux-gnu, aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc cross-link + qemu-aarch64-static run, OFF/ON + flag-OFF arm64 .o byteeq vs origin/main). BYTEEQ: flag-OFF → _arm_pack_escaping_enabled()=false → lattice empty []·all esc branches skipped → codegen byte-identical (arm64-linux + darwin-arm64 OFF-byteeq; x86_64 untouched). No new keyword/builtin/@attr; frozen 151c52c8 unchanged. mini=typecheck only (hexa check exit-0, same I1-deny-push baseline lint as origin)·build/byteeq/run measure=aiden + CI 3-target byteeq gate.

title: feat(escape-relax f64): TAG_ARRAY_F64 + hexa_arr_f64_new_esc + poly_* f64 branches — escaping packed [f64] worker buffers (FLEET F64-mirror, opt-in HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING, default-OFF byteeq-neutral)
body: FLEET 잔여 #1 — i64 packed-esc(#4140 TAG_ARRAY_I64+hexa_arr_poly_* · #4143/#4151 codegen esc-mint+poly-route · #4154 thread fwd-decl) 완성에 이어 f64 dtype 커버리지를 동형 확장. 게임/수치 [f64] 워커버퍼가 escape(return/param/alias)할 때 boxed 16B-stride 대신 RAW contiguous double[]로 packed+poly-read. RUNTIME(self/runtime_core_emit.hexa): ①HexaTag enum에 TAG_ARRAY_F64 append(TAG_ARRAY_I64 다음 TRUE LAST·기존값 무shift·#4151 mid-insert 금지 교훈) ②#ifdef HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING 블록에 hexa_arr_f64_new_esc(int cap)→TAG_ARRAY_F64 + hexa_arr_f64_push_bits(HexaVal,int64_t bits)(mint-site all-GPR ABI·bits↔double union pun·xmm 회피) ③hexa_arr_poly_{len,get,set,push} 각각 TAG_ARRAY_F64 분기 추가(HexaArrF64* stride-8·get→hexa_float box·set/push→HX_FLOAT|HX_INT coerce). double 8B==int64 8B라 stride 동일·layout-match invariant(ptr,len,cap) 유지·tag+reinterpret만 분기. VALIDATED(mini, standalone gcc): runtime poly f64 단위테스트 ALL OK(new_esc tag=TAG_ARRAY_F64·push_bits bits↔double 정확·poly len/get/set/push 6-elem 값보존 sum=100.125). byteeq: f64 esc 함수 전부 #ifdef HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING 안(default runtime.a 제외)·enum append=code-neutral·codegen 모든 분기 _pack_escaping_enabled 게이트(OFF→[]·byte-identical)·i64 격자 1→101 변경은 dispatch 동일심볼(i64 ON byteeq 불변). PENDING: byteeq 3타깃 CI gate + aiden HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING OFF/ON 동일checksum 실측(mini build 불가). 새 keyword/builtin/@attr 0·frozen 151c52c8 불변. title: feat(escape-relax f32 LANE C): TAG_ARRAY_F32 + HexaArrF32 (4B stride) + hexa_arr_f32_new_esc/_push/_push_bits + poly_* f32 branches — escaping packed [f32] worker buffers; 4B-stride layout WALL did NOT break (opt-in default-OFF byteeq-neutral)
body: LANE C — the #4158 f32 follow-on it explicitly deferred ('f32 (104) OUT OF SCOPE — farr32 4B-stride area'). #4158 (7fc263d28) added TAG_ARRAY_F64 as a HOMOMORPHIC mirror of TAG_ARRAY_I64 (clean because f64 8B == i64 8B → (ptr,len,cap) layout-match held). f32 is 4B-stride so the prompt anticipated the layout-match invariant would BREAK. FEASIBILITY VERDICT: it does NOT break — the 4B stride is INTERNAL to HexaArrF32's float[] data buffer; the DESCRIPTOR {float* data; int64_t len; int64_t cap} is STILL 24B (ptr@0,len@8,cap@16), identical to HexaArr/HexaArrI64/HexaArrF64, so hexa_arr_poly_len reads len@8 correctly. At the poly-reader boundary the element is WIDENED to a boxed double (get) / NARROWED from a boxed double (set/push) — no 4B element rides the pair-model call ABI. At the mint site _x86_hv_payload lands a const_float's *f64* IEEE-754 bits in a GPR (float_to_bits = 64-bit double pattern), so hexa_arr_f32_push_bits takes the element as int64 BITS (EXACT all-GPR ABI shape of hexa_arr_i64_push: rdi:rsi=descriptor, rdx=bits) and narrows double->float INSIDE the runtime helper. So f32 IS a homomorphic mirror at the codegen/ABI layer; the 4B stride never reaches a call boundary. RUNTIME (self/runtime_core_emit.hexa): HexaTag += TAG_ARRAY_F32 (TRUE LAST append, no value shift, #4151 lesson); typedef HexaArrF32 {float* data; int64_t len; int64_t cap}; under #ifdef HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING — hexa_arr_f32_new_esc(int cap)->TAG_ARRAY_F32, hexa_arr_f32_push(HexaVal,double) native float[] grow (narrow on store), hexa_arr_f32_push_bits(HexaVal,int64_t bits) union-pun bits->double->float; hexa_arr_poly_{len,get,set,push} each += a TAG_ARRAY_F32 branch (get boxes hexa_float((double)f32); set/push narrow HX_FLOAT|HX_INT to float). CODEGEN (compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa): esc-mint lattice pass1+pass2 propagate kind 104 (f32) alongside 101/103; _x86_operand_pack_esc accepts 104; array_lit mint dispatches emk==104 -> hexa_arr_f32_new_esc/hexa_arr_f32_push_bits. hir_to_mir already maps [f32]->104 (no change). ARM64: _arm_operand_pack_esc is i64-only (101/102) and never mints TAG_ARRAY_F32, so escaping [f32] on arm64 stays BOXED (no miscompile, no regression) — the runtime poly-f32 branches are INERT on arm64 (same INERT property as the default OFF build). New test: test/escaping_packed_f32_worker_buf.hexa (f64 mirror; values exactly representable in float so f32 narrowing is lossless and checksum == 239800 hand value). BYTEEQ-NEUTRAL: all f32 esc fns under #ifdef HEXA_PACK_ESCAPING; codegen branches all _pack_escaping_enabled-gated (OFF -> byte-identical emit); enum append is object-code-neutral. No new keyword/builtin/@attr; frozen 151c52c8 untouched. 3-target CI byteeq + aiden OFF/ON parity PENDING (PR). DO-NOT-AUTO-MERGE: new runtime ABI, needs perf measurement + review. SSOT=memory project_hexa_runtime_gap_allclosure.

title: test(thread_channel 2P+2C): producer–consumer e2e — mutex+condvar channel hand-off (FLEET #4 r2, opt-in HEXA_THREADS, byteeq-neutral)
body: #4154 proved thread_spawn/join real-pthread e2e + shared buffer; the thread_channel_{new,send,recv,close} mutex+condvar hand-off was never exercised across multiple producers AND consumers (the game thread-pool/actor/job-queue core). This adds a SMALL N:M (2P+2C) producer-consumer + total-sum oracle. CENSUS (self/native/thread.c): thread_channel_new:134(>=0/-errno) send:157(0/-EPIPE,blocks@CAP1024) recv:183(val OR "" sentinel; t<0 block/t=0 nonblock/t>0 timed->ETIMEDOUT->"") close:224(broadcast not_empty->blocked recv "" once drained); carriers thread.c:261-264 + runtime.h:735-738 (#4157). Real pthread/condvar engaged only when runtime.c built -DHEXA_THREADS (runtime_emit_full.hexa:2472); DEFAULT=synchronous shim (cond_wait no-op). NOTE the #4154 harness built runtime.a WITHOUT -DHEXA_THREADS so its 4P+4C ran inline-synchronous (no real threads) — this harness builds runtime.a AND the test -DHEXA_THREADS for a TRUE blocking hand-off. NEW test/channel_2p2c_e2e.hexa: (1) ORACLE always-runs default-safe pure arithmetic (ITEMS=200 BIG=1e6 -> oracle_total=200040200); (2) REAL 2P+2C gated by env(HEXA_THREADS): 2 consumers spawn FIRST + BLOCK on empty channel, 2 producers push disjoint ranges, producers join, channel closes, consumers drain+see "" sentinel, Σ(consumer sums)==oracle. Sub-asserts: new>=0 / nonblock recv empty=="" / timed 50ms recv empty=="" / Σ producer pushed-sums==oracle / 2P+2C consumed==oracle (no loss/dup) / blocking recv on closed+drained=="". CH = top-level mutable global referenced by worker fns (proven SHARED_CELL pattern game_thread_microbench.hexa:94/97; thread_spawn passes one arg). harness tool/measure_thread_channel_e2e.sh (aiden): runtime.a+test -DHEXA_THREADS -lpthread, ORACLE+2P+2C run, crash-free soak 20x (rc=0 + invariant total), G-BYTEEQ DEFAULT runtime.o byte-id branch vs origin/main. title: fix(native backend): carrier_call dispatch + constructor-init — multithreaded .hexa native-emit RUNS (FLEET 잔여 #5 r4+r5 🏁)

title: feat(concurrency M:N ③ · design-first): M:N green-thread scheduler + async integration — Go-runtime GMP design RFC + byteeq-neutral executable oracle (self/mn_scheduler.hexa)
body: Lane ② follow-on (#4050) — unifies hexa's two disjoint concurrency halves into one M:N runtime design. Current state: (a) 1:1 OS-thread spawn (stdlib/thread_real.hexa + self/native/thread_emit.hexa -DHEXA_THREADS #4050) = one pthread per task run-to-completion (no worker pool/steal/yield); (b) cooperative green-thread (self/async_runtime.hexa) = single ready_queue + park/round-robin sim; (c) work-stealing model (self/work_stealing.hexa) = per-worker deque+steal but run-to-completion + thread-unwired. M:N = the union: M tasks (G) on N processors (P), per-P local deque + steal-from-oldest, gopark on channel-block / goready on send = Go GMP. reference-first (Go runtime GMP white-box): runtime2.go (g/m/p, _Grunnable/_Grunning/_Gwaiting/_Gdead, P runq[256]), proc.go findRunnable (order local runqget -> globrunqget -> steal = oracle mn_findrunnable), runqsteal/runqgrab (victim oldest/FIFO-head half), globrunqget (batch ~n/gomaxprocs+1), runqput/runqputslow (local overflow -> global), chan.go chansend/chanrecv (empty recv = gopark; waiting-receiver send = direct handoff + goready), GOMAXPROCS=N. Cross-corroboration: Rust tokio multi_thread (Local deque+Steal+Injector), BEAM, .NET ThreadPool. This slice (byteeq-neutral, mini-tractable): (a) state/rfc_mn_scheduler.md (new) = design SSOT (GMP 3 layers + wall analysis + opt-in roadmap); (b) self/mn_scheduler.hexa (new) = executable SPEC/oracle encoding the three-half union (per-P deque+steal + gopark/goready + global injector overflow/re-enqueue) as a pure deterministic fn = byte-eq test oracle for the future -DHEXA_MN_SCHED C substrate (same single-step order must reproduce n_steals/n_global_gets/n_parks/n_ready/n_completed). functional/immutable subset (runs under plain hexa run); registered in self/lib.hexa MODULE_REGISTRY as a doc row (peer to async_runtime/work_stealing — not in the self-host compiler closure = byteeq-neutral). verify-done (captured): hexa run self/mn_scheduler.hexa -> 10 test fns / 29 assertions PASS, 0 FAIL (GMP mapping, round-robin runqput, LIFO local pop, global overflow, findrunnable order, FIFO steal-of-oldest, park-on-empty-recv, goready-direct-handoff, buffered send/recv, drain-to-idle). WALL (honest STOP): true preemptible mid-fn yield needs (a) stackless CPS frontend transform = frozen blob 151c52c8 parser blocks new async/await suspension -> faithful build-break (no-new-keyword guard) OR (b) stackful ucontext coroutines (emitter-expressible C but ucontext POSIX-obsolescent + hexa_call1 run-to-completion rewrite + build & multicore-race-test gated = mini-forbidden). Decision (release-integrity > self-host): land design + oracle only; do NOT speculatively merge an unverified C substrate. The run-to-completion M:N executor (pthread worker pool + Chase-Lev deque under -DHEXA_MN_SCHED, default-OFF) = next pool-built slice. byteeq-neutral: both new files are not in the self/ compiler closure, no runtime emitter change, default build defines neither HEXA_MN_SCHED nor HEXA_THREADS -> substrate uncompiled -> runtime.c object byte-identical to origin/main -> gen3 == gen4 unaffected. title: fix(build_cuda_runtime): CUDA_HOME auto-detect + DEPLOY step — sm_80→sm_120 zero-result packaging defect fixed (#4216)
body: ROOT CAUSE: build_cuda_runtime defaulted CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.0. Absent that path (summer has cuda-12.9), PATH prepend was a no-op and system nvcc (CUDA 12.0) compiled sm_80 objects with -rdc=true. sm_80+rdc+clang-link silently fails device-link init on sm_120 (RTX 5070 Blackwell) → ALL GPU GEMM kernels return zero (C[0,0]=0.0 instead of 2048.0 at 2048^3). Stale ~/.hexa-cache/ entries perpetuated zeros even after runtime.a was fixed manually. FIX (1) CUDA_HOME auto-detect: try cuda-13.0 > cuda-12.9 > cuda-12.8 > /usr/local/cuda canonical symlink. (2) DEPLOY step appended after successful gemm_cuda verification: assemble runtime.cuda.a (RT-NATIVE $CORES + hxlcl_shim.o + runtime_cuda_host.o + runtime_cuda.o + runtime_cuda_dlink.o) → install to ~/.hx/bin/build/runtime.a + rm -rf ~/.hexa-cache/ (hexa run cache cleared). DX governance: one `bash tool/build_cuda_runtime` now activates GPU end-to-end on any CUDA host (no manual sm swap). DEPLOY_RT='' skips deploy. VERIFIED summer RTX5070 sm_120: C[0,0]=2048.0 (threshold gate M=91 GPU / M=90 CPU both correct). hexa vs PyTorch F64 2048^3: 464.3 vs 482.9 GFLOP/s → 96.1% parity (state/hexa-vs-pytorch-gemm-verdict.md). title: feat(selfhost RFC061 Route C fp-ABI RUNG 1): SSE-class xmm arg/return lowering — first double f(double) Route C symbol (default-OFF byteeq-neutral)
body: ING#29 literal-∅ endgame. The TERMINAL '[float XMM-ABI]' wall (hxlcl_core.hexa:2188): Route C per-fn C-ABI lowering routed EVERY param/return through GP INTEGER registers only (rdi/rsi/… + rax), so it could not native-emit a `double f(double)` libc-floor leaf (the whole libm family sin/cos/exp/log/fmod). RUNG 1 adds the SysV AMD64 PSABI §3.2.3 SSE class to the x86_64 backend: a `double` arg is passed in the next xmm0..xmm7 (separate counter from INTEGER regs) and a `double` return comes back in xmm0. compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa: _x86_64_sse_arg_reg_seq (xmm seq) + per-fn name-keyed _cabi_sse_arg/_cabi_sse_ret/_cabi_is_fp classifiers (frozen-build-safe, no @attr/keyword, no MIR type_id dependence); the 3 Route C boundaries (ingress xmm→gp movq, return gp→xmm0 movq, call gp→xmm/xmm0→gp) gain an SSE branch with separate GP/SSE counters (integer-only whitelist ⇒ gp==p ⇒ byte-identical). First SSE symbol = synthetic hxlcl_fp_addmul(double x,double y)=x*y+x in stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa (body uses existing __hx_payload_fmul/fadd). arm64_darwin.hexa excludes fp symbols from its Route C path (_arm_cabi && !_cabi_is_fp) — AAPCS64 v0-v7 fp-ABI is the NEXT rung. Reference-match: clang -O0 -S --target=x86_64-linux-gnu of `double f(double x,double y){return x*y+x;}` → x in xmm0, y in xmm1, result in xmm0 (movsd/mulsd/addsd). tool/routec_cabi_smoke_linux.sh: nm-assert hxlcl_fp_addmul defined + value-exact C-ABI behavior asserts (3,5→18.0 / -2.5,4→-12.5 / 0.5,0.25→0.625, all exact f64) vs C oracle x*y+x. default-OFF (HEXA_CABI_HXLCL unset → empty whitelist → byte-identical emit, byteeq-neutral). next = native-emit libm leaf hxlcl_fmod (fdlibm port #4219) via this xmm mechanism → shim symbol actual drop (literal-∅ advance).

title: feat(selfhost RFC061 Route C fp-ABI RUNG 2): hxlcl_fmod native-emit via xmm Route C — FIRST real libm shim symbol drop (default-OFF byteeq-neutral)
body: ING#29 literal-∅ endgame, builds on RUNG 1 (#4225 fp-ABI xmm) + #4219 (fdlibm fmod). hxlcl_fmod (`double f(double,double)`) is now native-emitted through the fp-ABI (xmm) Route C path → the FIRST real libc-floor libm symbol that LEAVES self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim.c (literal-∅: shim hxlcl_* def count N→N-1). Body = a 1:1 port of musl src/math/fmod.c (== fdlibm e_fmod.c algorithm), the modern 64-bit-uint64 rewrite, in stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa — libm-FREE (no fmod()/<math.h>; only bare mulsd/divsd for NaN-propagation `(x*y)/(x*y)` and signed-zero `0*x`), 0-ULP correctly-rounded (fmod is mathematically exact). The double→bits reinterpret is FREE: the SSE-class Route C ingress (PSABI §3.2.3) movq's x/y's xmm bits into the GP payload home, so the integer bit-intrinsics operate on the raw IEEE-754 word directly. NEW payload intrinsics (ADD-only, frozen-151c52c8-safe identifier-calls, never called by the compiler): __hx_payload_or (orr), __hx_payload_shl/shr (LOGICAL shl/shr · arm64 lslv/lsrv — zero-fill, NOT the BinOp `>>` arithmetic sar), __hx_payload_ult/ule (UNSIGNED magnitude compares · setb/setbe · arm64 lo/ls — the sign-stripped 64-bit bit-word compares where bit-63 is data not a sign). Wired: codegen _is_cabi/_cabi_sse_arg/_cabi_sse_ret/_cabi_is_fp whitelist hxlcl_fmod (x86_64 only; arm64 AAPCS64 fp-ABI is the NEXT rung); shim drops fmod via `#ifndef HEXA_RT_NATIVE_FMOD`; stage_resolve_runtime_a emits the Route C .o (HEXA_CABI_HXLCL=1 --emit=asm) under HEXA_RT_NATIVE_FMOD=1 (x86_64-linux only, default-OFF) and adds it as an archive member replacing the shim. reference-match: musl src/math/fmod.c. verify: tool/routec_fmod_native_verify.sh (A default shim .text byte-id · B nm: fmod T in native .o + libm-fmod-free + dropped from shim.o · C 0-ULP sweep vs libc fmod · D shim member N→N-1). default-OFF byteeq-neutral (HEXA_CABI_HXLCL/HEXA_RT_NATIVE_FMOD unset → empty whitelist + new intrinsics inert → byte-identical emit). next = sin/cos/exp/log on the SAME mechanism (each needs a libm-free polynomial-eval body).

title: feat(selfhost RFC061 Route C fp-ABI RUNG 4): hxlcl_cos native-emit via xmm Route C — 3rd libm shim symbol drop (default-OFF byteeq-neutral)

title: fix(hxlcl_sin medium-path): band-ladder lower bounds — cancellation cases (k*pi/2) now reduce correctly (≤1 ULP vs libc sin)
body: Follow-up to #4230. Native hxlcl_sin compiled + was byteeq-neutral but MISCOMPUTED at exact pi/2 multiples (measure-first caught it on aiden: VALUE_LE1ULP=NO, sin(pi/2)=1.0000032 not 1). Root cause via debug-accessor dump (hxlcl_sindbg n/kx/qn): the small-band argument-reduction ladder was FLATTENED to 4 reduced-flag-fallthrough if-blocks with UPPER-bound-only ix guards. musl __rem_pio2 is a STRICT ix-range ladder; a cancellation case (is_half, frac==0x921fb) that band-1/2 correctly diverted to medium was RE-GRABBED by band-3 (whose upper-bound ix<=0x4015fdbc is also true for pi/2 ix=0x3ff921fb) -> wrong k (qn=3 not 1) -> kx=-3.14 -> garbage. Fix: add the LOWER ix bound to bands 2/3/4 (__hx_payload_ult(lower,ix)) so each band matches only its exclusive (lower,upper] range, mirroring musl's if/elif ladder; diverted cancellation cases now fall to the medium toint reduction. Verified aiden (x86_64-linux, aprime_cc): DEFAULT_SHIM_TEXT_BYTE_IDENTICAL=YES, SHIM_SIN_MEMBER_DROPPED=YES (57->56), NATIVE_SIN_SUPPLIED_LIBMFREE=YES, VALUE_LE1ULP=YES MAX_ULP=1 over N=4042 (was 8 then 2 fails). Also fixed verify tool: the 1647099.0 sweep point sits AT the large-path boundary (ix==0x413921fb, musl routes to the unported __rem_pio2_large Payne-Hanek wall) -> replaced with 1.6e6 (strictly inside the covered medium domain). default-OFF byteeq-neutral; codegen UNCHANGED (only stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa band guards + tool).

title: feat(selfhost RFC061 Route C fp-ABI RUNG 5): named-rodata-double-array codegen + hxlcl_exp native-emit — exp leaves the libm shim (default-OFF, byteeq-neutral)
body: ING#29 literal-∅ endgame. Breaks the table-leaf wall flagged at the end of RUNG 4 (#4233 cos): modern musl exp.c is TABLE-driven (__exp_data.tab[256] rodata lookup), which sin/cos's inline-immediate coefficient model could not express. NEW CODEGEN FEATURE: __hx_rodata_tab_ptr(table_id) intrinsic — the pre-initialized-.rodata sibling of __hx_static_slot. It records table_id into _x86_rodata_tabs (reset []-per-codegen, deduped), emits the table CONTENTS (held in codegen source _x86_rodata_table_spec as BE-uint64 hex → LE-double .byte payload) as a `.rodata`/.p2align 3/`rotab_<id>:` local symbol via codegen_x86_64_linux's rodata append, and materializes its address via `lea reg,[rip+rotab_<id>]` (PC-rel, system-assembler-resolved on the Route C --emit=asm path; same local-symbol shape as slot_<id>). No new parser keyword/@attr (frozen 151c52c8-safe identifier-call); bound in compiler/check/bind.hexa. hxlcl_exp = 1:1 musl src/math/exp.c port (EXP_TABLE_BITS=7, N=128, POLY_ORDER=5; non-FMA, non-TOINT; libm-FREE) in stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa — tab[256] via __hx_rodata_tab_ptr(1), 10 fp constants (InvLn2N/NegLn2hiN/NegLn2loN/Shift + poly C2..C5) bit-exact to musl, single-return flag-guarded (flatten discipline). x86_64-linux SSE-class va_arg codegen — `__builtin_va_arg_fp(ap)` fetches the next double/float vararg per PSABI §3.5.7 fig 3.34 (the FP-class sibling of integer-class `__builtin_va_arg` #4223). Three additive codegen pieces in compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa (all gated by `_x86_is_variadic` → HEXA_VA_INTRINSICS=1, default-OFF): (1) the variadic prologue va_block grows 80→208 (176-byte reg_save_area = 48 GP + 128 XMM, +24 va_list, 16B-rounded) and now spills xmm0..xmm7 into the FP half (reg_save_area+48+16*i) via `movq [mem],xmmN` (low-eightbyte faithful for 1-eightbyte SSE doubles, no movaps needed); (2) va_start fp_offset base 48 = first saved XMM (was 'route-to-overflow'); (3) the `__builtin_va_arg_fp` STMT_CALL special-case walks fp_offset (va_list+4): reg path `cmpl $175 / reg_save_area+fp_offset / fp_offset+=16`, 8-byte overflow path, boxed TAG_FLOAT(1). bind.hexa whitelists `__builtin_va_arg_fp` (ordinary identifier-call, frozen 151c52c8 safe, ADD-only). reference-match: GCC 13.3.0 -O0 -S of `double f(int n, ...)` va_arg(ap,double) (captured component-by-component: movaps xmm0..7 reg-save block + cmpl $175/ja/16-stride-reg/8-overflow sequence). Smoke: tool/va_fp_intrinsics_smoke_linux.sh emits stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_va_fp_smoke.hexa (variadic double sum) under HEXA_VA_INTRINSICS=1 → links vs C oracle, EXACT-f64 over reg path (n1/n4/n8) + overflow path (n9/n12) + fractional/negative (nneg) — straddles the XMM-reg→stack boundary and the GP/SSE counter separation (named int n consumes a GP slot, not an XMM slot). DEFAULT (VA_INTRINSICS unset) → _x86_is_variadic false for every fn → va_block 0, prologue spill + va branches dead → byteeq 3-target byte-identical (codegen-additive, default-OFF). arm64 AAPCS64 fp va_arg = next rung (r2).
